data.title: Government Subsidy Impersonation Domain — NRD with Agency Keyword Pattern
data.description: Detects newly registered domains (< 30 days) matching government agency impersonation patterns combined with subsidy/relief keywords. Targets domains like gov*-subsidy*, dwp-*, hmrc-*, irs-*, fema-*, *-relief-payment, and country-agency combinations (uk-energy-*, us-fuel-*). CrimsonVector confirmed gov.dwp-subsidy.shop as a phishing site impersonating the UK Department for Work and Pensions during the 2026 oil shock. The NRD age filter (< 30 days) eliminates legitimate government domains while catching the 48-72h post-announcement registration surge.
references: CrimsonVector, 2026 Iran War Oil Shock Domain Intelligence Report — gov.dwp-subsidy.shop confirmed phishing
UK NCSC, Government Impersonation Phishing Advisories
FBI IC3, 2025 Internet Crime Report — Government impersonation: $797.9M
falsepositives: Legitimate government contractor domains registered for program support
News aggregator or comparison sites covering government programs
Academic or research domains studying government policy
